proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord.attunementEligibility
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing record can represent only a boolean attunement requirement, not who is eligible to attune. This item's spellcasting, recharge, and destruction fit cleanly, but the attunement gate is still lost.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Wand, Rare (Requires Attunement by a Spellcaster)

notes: Encoded honestly as a charge-cast magic-item activation. Typecheck and tracer both passed. The only omitted rule text is the attunement eligibility clause 'by a spellcaster'.
